about: spark at work: one person's real task a case, run end to end through the real command (tests/use_cases.py). who: new (the first day with spark), dev, ops, office, learn (a student), app (a tool that is a client of spark, called the way its plugin calls it), hostile (what real input does to a tool: binary, empty, huge, a secret, a hidden instruction, Ctrl-C). Each check is one key; tests/use_cases.py says what each means.

cases.title: what can spark do for me
cases.cmd: $SPARK what can you do for me on this machine, in a few lines

cases.title: how much disk space is left
cases.cmd: printf '%s\n' 'how much disk space is left' | $SPARK line --cwd "$PWD" --shell bash

cases.title: what program is using port 8080
cases.cmd: printf '%s\n' 'what program is using port 8080' | $SPARK line --cwd "$PWD" --shell bash
